# Evacuation-Planner.com

> Free emergency floor plan creation tool with ISO safety symbols for hotels, offices, and public buildings.

Evacuation-Planner.com is a web-based platform that enables users to design professional evacuation and rescue floor plans using standardized ISO safety icons. The tool supports multiple languages including English, German, French, and Thai, with both free and pro versions available for different user needs.

## Core Platform

- [Evacuation-Planner.com – Free emergency floor plan tool](https://evacuation-planner.com): Free emergency floor plan tool for hotels, offices, public buildings with ISO safety signs
- [Upgrade your account now!](https://evacuation-planner.com/pro-version.html): Pro version upgrade page with PNG/SVG export and additional icon features

## Language Versions

- [Evacuation-Planner.com – Kostenlose Flucht- und Rettungspläne selbst erstellen](https://evacuation-planner.com/de): German language version of emergency floor plan creation tool for buildings
- [Evacuation-Planner.com - Outil de plan d'évacuation d'urgence gratuit](https://evacuation-planner.com/fr): French language version of free emergency evacuation floor plan tool
- [Evacuation-Planner.com – เครื่องมือสร้างแผนอพยพฟรี](https://evacuation-planner.com/th): Thai language version for creating free evacuation floor plans with ISO symbols
